interest: Shows 1931-39 US tracking of Japanese capital in China, from Manchukuo investment hesitancy to Hankow's business consolidation.
overview: Docket (1931-39) on Japanese capital in China/Manchuria: business reports from Shanghai, Tsingtao, Hankow, boycott losses, North China economic planning, and Manchukuo investment hesitancy under Matsuoka.

people.name: Frank P. Jones
people.role: Officer, Division of Far Eastern Affairs

people.name: Yōsuke Matsuoka
people.role: President of the South Manchuria Railway

subfiles.about: A Department of State docket sheet recording incoming and outgoing correspondence, memoranda, and cross-references regarding Japanese capital investments and business enterprises in China between 1931 and 1939.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1931-39) for file 894.503193 (China) indexing Japanese business in Shanghai, Tsingtao, and Hankow, boycott losses, North China development plans, and a Manchuria-investment inquiry.
subfiles.title: List of Papers: Investment of Japanese Capital in China
